hook.name: RiseHook
hook.description: A tokenomics hook that charges an ETH fee on sells, accumulates proceeds as ERC-6909 claims, and when reserves cross a configurable threshold, atomically market-buys its own token through the same pool and queues tokens for burning. Buybacks and burns are permissionless and can also be triggered externally via `buyback()` and `flushBurn()`.
